clean_body: An earthquake ended. A different danger didn't end. After the earthquakes in Venezuela, traffickers are already moving. Here's how we're responding. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Peter, The earthquakes in Venezuela dominated the news for a matter of days. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, the world watched, then largely moved on. But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. In some ways, it was only the beginning. Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear. We've set an urgent goal to raise $50,000 in the next 30 days to help rescue children, provide safe shelter, and reunite families before more children disappear into trafficking. Every gift brings us one step closer.Will you help us reach this lifesaving goal today? I've sat with survivors. I've heard what it costs a family to lose a child this way, and what it takes to bring one home. And I've learned that disasters like the one in Venezuela don't create new evil, they simply hand existing evil an opening it has used again and again. If this is the first time you're hearing from me, my name is Eduardo Verastegui, and I produced the film Sound of Freedom. The film Sound of Freedom was truly a movie that launched a movement. That movement is now. Our mission at the Sound of Freedom Foundation is to stop the sale of God's children. We do that through five pillars: Prevention Intervention Education Information Influence We are working urgently, with trusted partners on the ground, to: Find children who have already fallen into trafficking, including exploitation happening online in the chaos of the disaster. Support rescue operations that bring a child out of danger and into safety. Provide a safe bed the moment a child is free. Fund reunification when a family can be found and verified. Walk alongside a child through long-term care when there is nowhere safe to send them yet. "Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked." (Psalm 82:3-4) That command is what guides every decision this Foundation makes. It is not a suggestion. It is not poetry. It is an instruction, and I take it as one. We're trusting God to help us raise $50,000 in the next 30 days, but He often answers prayers through people willing to act. I hope you'll be one of them today. Peter, I am asking you urgently, humbly, and personally to make your first gift today. Please do not wait. For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Right now, a displaced child in Venezuela is being watched by someone who does not have their best interest at heart. Your gift today helps make sure someone who does gets there first. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Friend,
In 250 years of American history, we have never faced a moment quite like this one.
**The Democratic Party is being swallowed whole by an openly socialist, anti-American wing.**
This is not name-calling. Their own platform calls for gutting our military, nationalizing private companies, abolishing cash bail, throwing open the border, and handing voting rights to noncitizens.
Their radicals are beating establishment Democrats in primary after primary. Zohran Mamdani was just the beginning.
_But here is what most Americans still do not understand, and it worries me deeply._
**The Democrats have already rigged the system. And they did it through illegal immigration.**
It works like this. Our Census counts every single resident, citizens and illegal aliens alike, when it hands out House seats and Electoral College votes.
So every illegal alien sitting in a blue state quietly pads that state's power in Washington, D.C.
Elon Musk has been sounding the alarm on this, and he is exactly right. Record illegal immigration has already shifted an estimated 15 to 20 House seats toward the Left.
Now you understand why they fight secure borders and deportations so ferociously.
**That is the entire scheme. Flood the country. Inflate the count. Redraw the maps. Lock in permanent one-party power. **
President Trump fought to base representation on American citizens where it belongs. The courts blocked him at every turn. But the plot is now out in the open for all of us to see.
Which brings me to the SAVE Act, and to my single greatest fear in this fight...
Not enough Americans even know what it is. **One poll found that only 23% could accurately describe it.** That is a catastrophe, because you cannot rally the people to save something they have never had explained to them.
**So let me tell you plainly what this bill does: The SAVE Act bars noncitizens from voting, so that only American citizens ever cast a ballot in an American election. And it requires photo ID to vote.** _**Period.** _
That is the whole fight, in two sentences.
And the American people are with us by margins you almost never see in politics. Nearly 80% want proof of citizenship to register. More than 8 in 10 support voter ID, including most Democrats, most independents, every background and every region. It is 5 to 1.
**Yet every single Democrat is fighting to block it.** _**Every one.** _
I have spent a lifetime in these battles, and I will tell you the hard truth. You never win reform inside Washington, D.C. The lobbyists and the entrenched forces always control the inside game.
Reagan understood this. His job, he said, was to shine a light on the American people so they would turn up the heat on Congress. Tip O'Neill once admitted to me that Reagan's speeches cost him 46 Democrats in a single fight.
**That is exactly how we win this one. Not with insiders. With a grassroots army of patriots like you, moving all at once.**

name: Adam Dunigan for Congress
subject: A Literal Picture of My Apartment Right Now (and some other stuff)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Adam for Congress
body:
You know, they said campaigning was thankless and exhausting. And they were right. But we're having fun. Occasionally. Very occasionally.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/VIEas2FT0lc?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| | | | | |
Hey, everyone! Adam here.
Giving you a newsletter update, straight from the campaign war room. The campaign war room is also, coincidentally, my dining room/kitchen/living room/open concept living space. My apartment is very small. Look at this disaster:
**Fig 1.** The campaign war room. From left to right, Dr. Jen Johannsen, Adam Tomlin, and Jacob “The Wunderkind of Northern Virginia Politics” Williams.
So here’s the update: _We’re doing really, really well._ Better than anybody expected at this point. There was a big [straw poll held last Saturday](https://us.list-manage.com/10QVtC3aH2E?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0), and after those results, people are starting to whisper about an upset victory here in Virginia’s 8th.
We’re dominating the field amongst the other challenger candidates, and we are in striking range of pulling this off. That’s all thanks to you guys, and language continues to fail in expressing my gratitude.
Our photographer, fellow Marine Corps combat veteran [Ted Stanton](https://us.list-manage.com/c2GBbwPO4t1?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0), recently put together some shots from the last few months. I encourage everyone to go check out [Ted’s photo essay](https://us.list-manage.com/fvmMMwRqf3y?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) on the Adam for Congress campaign. It captures the feeling of what we’re all trying to accomplish. I’m also going to try and forgive Ted for invading my privacy and catching me while I was still asleep in that one photo.
Thank you all for coming on this ride so far. Three weeks left. Here’s what’s afoot:
**Donations! (I know, I’m sorry)**
You already know it: I hate money in politics. And I hate asking, so I’ll make this short: We are currently just shy of [$250,000 raised](https://us.list-manage.com/QUrQ08KM0MM?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). That number is a big deal in DC. And all of our money is clean; no corporate money, no special interests.
If everyone who sees this email can [donate today](https://us.list-manage.com/2WJdSEmLN0T?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0), we’ll have the advertising budget we need to win this race. And I, personally, won’t have to sell my other kidney.
If you can swing it, I’m asking for $100, but any amount helps. And if you can’t swing anything, no worries. If you just don’t want to donate, that’s also totally fine. God gave us that extra kidney for a reason. It’s basically the original Health Savings Account. [Please donate](https://us.list-manage.com/12g6tAwr76B?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). :(
**Events this week!**
The sun is shining, the birds are chirping, and the sky is clear. So, no excuse to not come and hang out at one of our upcoming events this week. Meet, chat, ask questions, or yell at me. I’m here for all of it. And our campaign social vibe is pretty fun. Even if you’re not very political, come make some new friends anyway.
**Thursday, 16 July - Candidate Meet and Greet, Arlington**
* 5:30pm, [Celtic House on Columbia Pike](https://us.list-manage.com/TWAdrPsiEIu?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
* I’ll be with fellow candidate Julie Farnam. Informal, don’t overthink it, just show up. It’s a bar! There’s no rules!
* Should be well attended by some of the homeowner associations, retiree communities, and other civically engaged groups from South Arlington.

**Friday, 17 July - Pub Crawl for Democracy, Arlington**
* 7:00pm, [Northside Social in Clarendon](https://us.list-manage.com/WMP9dsyStbc?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
* This one will be fun. We’ll get a single drink at each of the classic watering holes in Clarendon, working our way down Wilson and Clarendon Blvds til we hit Rosslyn, harassing venue patrons and youth voters along the way.
* Step-off from Northside to start the journey will commence promptly at 8:00pm.

**Saturday, 18 July - 2000s Karaoke, Alexandria**
* 7:30pm, [Rock It Grill in Alexandria](https://us.list-manage.com/17pVhpPhL5S?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
* 2000s karaoke night! Let the dulcet tones and amateur falsettos of a classic karaoke night Wake [you] Up Inside. There’s no downside to a karaoke night, only a Brightside. And Since U Been Gone from our campaign events lately, don’t you think it’s time we fixed that? Dont Cha?
* To be clear, Rock It Grill is not sponsoring this. We’re just showing up and ruining their playlist with 2000s song requests.

**Recent Media Hits!**
* I was in the [Washington Post recently](https://us.list-manage.com/RhXrnlptUfZ?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Kinda cool. Less cool is the fact that ICE is still murdering people and still hasn’t been abolished.
* Speaking of ICE, we had something of a [viral moment](https://us.list-manage.com/1AR1xeyxuUf?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) when we released our most recent ICE commentary on the killing of a US military veteran.
* We’ve also posted some [fresh Iran War analysis and commentary](https://us.list-manage.com/VcUQ1ArXOTk?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Check that out if you want to get further horrified.
* On the lighter side of things, I did a [half politics/half comedy stand up night](https://us.list-manage.com/muHbrqSSMaL?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) to meet voters. I think I did passably well.
* The evil political establishment machine released [a scathing attack ad about me](https://us.list-manage.com/qOOqzaJvWHR?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Lies and slander.

That’s all for now, friends. See you later this week, I hope.
\- Adam

#### _**[Endless Urgency is always free to read, but this community only grows because people choose to invest in it. Every subscription helps us reach further, build something lasting, and keep these urgent conversations alive. We'd love to have you with us. Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/1e24f0cf-044d-4c91-a805-4bbd38006526?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/1e24f0cf-044d-4c91-a805-4bbd38006526?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
On Tuesday, Supreme Court Justice Amy Coney Barrett sat in front of a House appropriations subcommittee -- the first time sitting justices have testified to Congress since 2019 -- and made the case for more security funding. She told the story of coming home with a bulletproof vest during the Dobbs leak fallout, setting it down in her bedroom, and turning around to find her 12-year-old son standing in the doorway asking what it was. She described a swatting incident at her home in May, her teenage son opening the front door to a street full of police cars responding to a fake 911 call. She said the threats have forced her kids "to think about and see things that children should not have to see or think about."
Let me be very clear about something up front: I don't want that for anybody. Not for Justice Barrett, not for her kids, not for anyone -- including people I have profound disagreements with, which absolutely includes Barrett and her Republican colleagues on the Court. Nobody's children should live like that. Full stop.
But I have to be honest with you about my immediate, gut-level reaction to that testimony, because it wasn't sympathy. It was rage. Deep in my soul, rage.
Because what she described -- that awful, stomach-turning experience of explaining an unthinkable threat to your own child -- is what millions of American parents do every single year. We just call it "back to school."
One of the worst days of parenting I've ever had was my son's first active shooter drill. The school sent home an instructional sheet ahead of time. An instructional sheet. How to talk to your kid about the possibility that a man with a gun might come to his classroom. He was too young to really understand any of it, but he understood enough to seem scared. He seemed unsafe. And I remember thinking: this is only going to get worse. Wait until he's old enough to actually understand what he's drilling for. Wait until it happens at his school, or the school one town over, or the school of a kid he knows.
What kind of learning environment are we creating when we ask children to rehearse for their own potential murder? And what kind of country are we running when the federal government will not do one damn thing to prevent it? We don't even acknowledge these shootings anymore. They happen constantly, and as long as the body count isn't too high, we just move on. We don't stop. We don't mourn. We've fully normalized it. That should horrify all of us, and instead it barely registers.
* * *
#### **[Endless Urgency is free to read--thanks to our paid subscribers. If this work has been useful to you, please help keep it available to everyone by becoming a paid subscriber. Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/1e24f0cf-044d-4c91-a805-4bbd38006526?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/1e24f0cf-044d-4c91-a805-4bbd38006526?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
So here's the thing that made my blood boil watching that hearing: safety in this country has become a privilege reserved for the children of the powerful. Justice Barrett's kids will get their security detail, and they should -- she holds one of the most consequential positions in American government, and the threats against her are real. But my kid deserves to be safe too. Your kid deserves to be safe. Every kid in every school in America deserves to be safe.
Instead, we live in a country where even modest attempts to make schools safer, whether through mental health resources, school safety investments, or keeping guns out of the hands of dangerous people -- are routinely blocked by Republicans in Congress. And if something did survive Congress? There's a very real chance it would end up before a Supreme Court that has spent years narrowing what government is allowed to do.
That's the part she doesn't seem to grasp. If she's expecting a groundswell of public sympathy, she should understand that she is actively contributing to the despair that so many Americans feel about their government. People have given up because nothing gets done. Everything is stalled. The Supreme Court isn't some neutral referee standing above that dysfunction. It's one of the institutions helping shape it. When people lose faith that government can solve problems, they don't separate Congress from the Court. They see one system that keeps failing them.
So yes, I feel for her. Genuinely. And it still comes off as profoundly tone-deaf -- another example of very powerful, very wealthy, very insulated people in Washington trapped in their echo chambers, with no idea how the rest of us live.
Because if you're not a parent, maybe you've never felt that sinking feeling of sending your kid off in the morning and not knowing, really knowing, that they'll come back. I feel it constantly. Sometimes when I drop my son off at school, I linger for a minute and just watch him hang out with his friends, because some part of me is scared something will happen to him. I can't protect him forever. I know that. I'm not trying to bubble-wrap his life or sand down every hard edge.
But damn it, maybe I can help build a world that's a little safer for him. A world where a bad man with a gun doesn't show up at his school.**** Where his school has what it needs. Where he has good health care. Where he can just be a kid. That's the bare minimum. Taking care of our kids -- all of our kids, not just the powerful ones -- is the least a functioning country should do.
Justice Barrett's children deserve to feel safe. So does mine. So does yours.
When do the rest of us get a hearing?

I want to tell you about Lorenzo.
For 35 years, he built homes in Houston. He raised three sons here. He was married to the woman he fell in love with as a teenager. He was so close to legal status that he'd already submitted his paperwork — every form, every appointment, every box checked.
None of that mattered on July 7th.
ICE agents were looking for someone else. They found Lorenzo's van instead, driving his crew to a job site before sunrise like he did every single day.
They chased him down in unmarked vehicles. An agent shot him through the passenger window. He bled out and died at the same hospital where his own sons were born.
The men riding with him say he never rammed anyone, never threatened anyone. The Harris County Medical Examiner has now ruled his death a homicide. The agents involved weren't even wearing body cameras.
This happened here. To one of our neighbors.
I refuse to let his name become just another headline.
I refuse to accept a government that treats immigration enforcement like a body count to hit instead of a system that respects human life and due process.

body:
August 4th is make or break for this campaign. Peter, earlier this month, we celebrated our nation's 250th birthday.

Milestones like this are a chance to reflect not only on our history, **but also on the responsibility each generation has to protect the democracy we've inherited.**

_That responsibility feels especially urgent right now._

Donald Trump and his circus of Republican yes-men in Congress are attacking the very institutions that have kept our democracy strong for all these years. They're undermining the rule of law, sowing distrust in our elections, and trying to drag our country backward.

_And they're doing it all without an ounce of shame._

I want to be as clear as I possibly can here, Peter: Celebrating this country — _and truly having love for it_ — means fighting for it. It means standing up for our democracy, protecting our freedoms, and making sure **every person** has a voice in the future we build together.

Look: the reason I decided to run for Congress in the first place is because I believe in the promise of this country. I believe the American Dream should still be within reach for every family willing to work hard. I believe our democracy is worth protecting. And I believe that when we come together, there isn't a challenge we can't overcome.

Donald Trump and his circus of Republican yes-men in Congress are attacking the very institutions that have kept our democracy strong for all these years. They're undermining the rule of law, sowing distrust in our elections, and trying to drag our country backward. And they're doing it all without an ounce of shame. ## _We wouldn’t be asking if it wasn’t urgent_
---
| | **Peter,**
**Yesterday, Shannon Taylor filed to create a joint fundraising committee with the Democratic Party of Virginia and launched a leadership PAC—two unprecedented steps for a candidate who hasn’t even won their primary yet.**
**Her goal is to bypass campaign finance regulations capping individual and organizational contributions. Now, Dominion Energy and big tech can resume pouring money into her campaign.**
**Make no mistake, this is happening because the party establishment is scared of the momentum we’re building. Together, we are showing that working class candidates with limited political experience can take on big fights and win. But the national party would rather prop up another career politician they can control, and they know I can’t be bought.**
**If you’re able, please consider chipping in $25—or whatever you can—to help us compete with the corporate money machine we’re up against. I don’t take any money from corporations or special interests; my only mission is to fight for ordinary people like you.**
**—Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs**

# [Why Jamie Dimon just poured $24 million into U.S. shipbuilding](https://substack.com/redirect/0f335abc-eb9e-4759-bd67-c1e250558adb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon **[announced a $24 million effort Wednesday to revive American shipbuilding,](https://substack.com/redirect/4fe2f257-9963-4cac-95ae-e2ba779f5409?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** including $18 million in loans and investments plus $6 million in grants for a new submarine manufacturing facility at the Philadelphia Navy Yard.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7aa5042f-2bd4-4f43-927c-33151c030c79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Arsenal of democracy reignited:** Dimon declared the arsenal of democracy has been reignited through the financing as part of the bank's larger security project amid rising geopolitical tensions.
* **Funding targets submarine facility:** The money will help finance the facility being built by Rhoads Industries along with expanded lending to maritime small businesses and regional suppliers.
* **Part of larger initiative:** The $24 million forms part of JPMorgan Chase $1.5 trillion program to finance industries critical to U.S. economic and national security.
* **South Korean partnership noted:** Dimon highlighted Hanwha shipbuilding operations at the Philadelphia Navy Yard as evidence the effort is advancing.

# [U.S. Navy drops $2.2 billion on powerful new Marine landing ships](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The U.S. Navy **[awarded a $2.2 billion contract to TOTE Services as Vessel Construction Manager](https://substack.com/redirect/44b7b73a-d002-4c72-a1db-12045c904de7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to accelerate production of up to eight Medium Landing Ships needed by the Marines for expeditionary operations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Accelerating shipbuilding process:** Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao announced the award uses a proven design and commercial best practices to deliver capabilities to the fleet faster than traditional methods.
* **Medium landing ships role:** The LSM program will transport Marines vehicles equipment and supplies in coastal and island environments with plans for an eventual 35 ship fleet.
* **Construction management created:** TOTE Services will hold the prime contract and manage shipyard subcontracts directly creating one accountable structure to reduce friction and align stakeholders.
* **Faster acquisition timeline:** The contract came five months from solicitation showing changes to the military acquisitions process under new priorities.

# [Morgan Stanley smashes records with 69% equities revenue surge](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Morgan Stanley **[posted record second quarter revenue of $21.35 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/e7ea0556-a7b4-4bb6-be28-ac1b4722d0f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and profit of $5.58 billion as equities trading revenue surged 69% to $6.3 billion driven by global artificial intelligence activity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Earnings beat estimates:** The firm reported earnings per share of $3.46 exceeding the $2.94 consensus with revenue topping the $19.64 billion forecast.
* **Equities trading record:** Equities trading hit a record $6.3 billion with notable strength in Asia fueled by heightened activity across the franchise.
* **Profit jumped 58%:** Profit climbed 58% from a year earlier to $5.58 billion amid strong trading performance matching peers.
* **Fixed income trading rose:** Fixed income trading increased 13% to $2.46 billion on good results in credit trading.

# [Smartphone shipments crash to 13-year low amid AI memory shortage](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Global **[smartphone shipments declined in the second quarter](https://substack.com/redirect/913cd8a1-0c9f-4b3d-9352-19eb6f45face?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Counterpoint Research reporting an 11% drop marking the worst Q2 in 13 years as the AI driven memory crisis intensified.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Memory costs surged sharply:** Memory costs are up nearly 300% from a year ago and now account for over 65% of bill of materials at the low end.
* **Low end vendors punished:** The crisis is favoring premium players like Apple and Samsung while punishing vendors exposed to entry level and mid range segments.
* **Shipments show polarization:** IDC estimated a 6.7% decline with severe market polarization as Chinese firms such as Xiaomi Oppo and Vivo bore the brunt.
* **Crisis may persist longer:** Analysts see the AI induced bottleneck potentially lasting into next year or further with some projections to 2030.

# [Meta employees sue over AI assisted discriminatory layoffs](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A group of current and former Meta employees sued the company alleging artificial intelligence systems used in the May layoffs of 10% of the workforce **[discriminated against those on protected medical or family leave.](https://substack.com/redirect/37afcdb9-fc6d-4695-a085-44712e0efb2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **AI systems ignored absences:** The constellation of internal artificial intelligence systems failed to account for approved absences when selecting employees for cuts.
* **Metrics penalize protected leave:** Tools draw on performance ratings productivity metrics AI native ratings and AI token consumption that cannot accumulate during protected leave or disability.
* **Lawsuit seeks injunction:** Plaintiffs request a preliminary injunction maintaining their employment status pending an independent audit of the algorithmically assisted selection process.
* **Meta denies AI decisions:** A Meta spokesperson stated workforce management decisions were and are made by people not AI and the claims lack merit.

* * *
* * *
# [New York imposes first US statewide AI data center ban](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
New York Governor Kathy Hochul **[signed an executive order barring construction of new hyperscale AI data centers](https://substack.com/redirect/aff07759-4bf5-4ad9-8dff-a0dbf27e0e3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** using 50 megawatts or more of power for up to one year citing grid strain and soaring electricity costs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d347b37f-dfe4-4d0e-b634-47b2ba5d7977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Power consumption threatens grid:** These hyperscale AI data centers consume enormous amounts of power truly threatening to outpace the state's grid capacity.
* **Electricity bills surged:** New Yorkers have seen average residential electricity prices climb nearly 68% since 2019 driving public opposition.
* **One year moratorium enacted:** The first statewide data center ban in the U.S. gives time to plan and ensure development does not come at the expense of ratepayers.
* **Public pressure drove action:** Leaders celebrated the move as a response to immense public pressure from communities fighting massive data center proposals.

#
Just imagine this scenario, Peter... It’s the morning of November 4th.
There are two situations we could find ourselves in:
1. **Democrats just dominated the midterms.** We built on the momentum we’ve seen since Donald Trump was elected in 2024 and used it to flip the Senate, take back the House, and elect Democrats up and down the ballot, all across the country.

2. **We let our energy fade and the GOP gained even more ground.** Now, they’re empowered to continue their assault on our democracy – unchecked for another two years, the remainder of Donald Trump’s term.

body:
Josh Shapiro failed to lead. Pennsylvania still brought home "Best in Show" because others stepped up.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/xNHSKi9jJjT?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter —
When Josh Shapiro decided Pennsylvania would not participate in the Great American State Fair he didn’t just make a political statement.
He let down Pennsylvania businesses, farmers, artisans, and workers who deserved the opportunity to showcase everything that makes our Commonwealth exceptional.
But fortunately, the story doesn’t end there.
Instead of accepting defeat, Senators Dave McCormick and John Fetterman put politics aside and worked together to ensure Pennsylvania was represented.
Thanks to their bipartisan leadership, Pennsylvania not only had a presence at the Fair...
**We won best in show!**
That outcome says everything.
When leaders lead, Pennsylvania wins.
When politicians play politics, Pennsylvanians lose.
Stacy Garrity saw that firsthand.
On the very first day of the Fair - before Pennsylvania’s booth was even opened - Stacy traveled to the fair to support Pennsylvania businesses and see what our Commonwealth was missing because of Shapiro’s failure to lead.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Pennsylvania should never have been in a position where two U.S. Senators had to step in to clean up a problem the Governor created.
But they did.
And because Dave McCormick and John Fetterman chose cooperation over partisanship, Pennsylvania received the recognition it deserved.
That’s the kind of leadership Pennsylvanians expect.
It’s also a reminder that putting Pennsylvania first isn’t about party labels.
It’s about showing up, working together, and doing what’s right for the Commonwealth.
Josh Shapiro failed that test.
Pennsylvania passed it anyway.
\- Team Garrity

name: Andy Beshear
subject: Who your governor is matters

body:
Peter, here’s something I’ve learned over the years:

For most people’s daily lives, who their governor is really matters — often even more than Congress.

Governors touch so many important parts of people’s lives: the wages they earn, the doctors they can see, the school they drop their kids off at, and the safety of their communities.

**That’s why I believe Democratic governors are our last — and most important — line of defense against the out-of-control Trump administration.**

[_**I'm on the road working to elect these leaders this fall, but I can't do it without folks like you. Can you make a contribution to In This Together PAC today? >>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135328693/633880851/330496673?refcode=ITT_ATA_EM_FR_Matters_260715_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjM3NDY1MzUtNzc4MC1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iYKlroEGi2cceRI4Z_VdsZbv5Zi97aquheEHf2fx2bA=)

And I can tell you firsthand, Democrats everywhere are **fired up and ready to fight.**

And we’re committed to competing and winning everywhere, even in states people have written off. I know it’s possible because we did it right here in Kentucky — winning three times in a state Trump won by over 30 points.

Peter – This is the last chance to reserve your spot for our Volunteer Kickoff! **Our Volunteer Kickoff is TONIGHT, Wednesday, July 15, at 7:00pm on Zoom, and you do not want to miss this opportunity.** Here is why tonight matters: Rick is the only candidate in this race willing to say out loud that the people in power have failed Mainers on housing, energy, and the cost of living, and then show exactly how he will fix it. Our volunteer team is how we carry that message from Farmington to Fort Kent, Kittery to Calais. Every door we knock on, every call we make, every neighbor we talk to is the difference between more of the same and a governor who delivers results. **We have the momentum, but tonight is where the real work begins.** If you have been waiting for the right moment to step in, this is it. body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1624%2E1086043%2E9S_P4d)
David Smith, the billionaire owner of the Baltimore Sun, _**is threatening to sue Wes Moore for telling the truth.**_
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260715-1.aAMD4f&refcode=em-20260715-1&t=2&akid=1624%2E1086043%2E9S_P4d)
**[Stand with Wes Moore by chipping in any amount to his re-election campaign right away »](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260715-1.aAMD4f&refcode=em-20260715-1&t=3&akid=1624%2E1086043%2E9S_P4d)**
Peter, a billionaire who owns one of Maryland’s biggest newspapers thinks he can sue Wes into silence. But this is bigger than one lawsuit or one billionaire. Americans should be deeply concerned when wealthy individuals who own major media organizations attempt to use legal threats to silence elected officials speaking on matters of public concern.
Whether their target is a governor, a journalist, or an ordinary citizen, the threat is the same: You should think twice before speaking, or else.
**This is not healthy for democracy.**
Criticism of the powerful shouldn’t come with an expensive legal bill attached. But make no mistake, Wes will continue to tell the truth, stand by the facts, and will not allow intimidation to dictate what he says on behalf of the people of Maryland.
**[If you stand with Wes Moore, show your support with a donation today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260715-1.aAMD4f&refcode=em-20260715-1&t=4&akid=1624%2E1086043%2E9S_P4d)**
Thank you,
Team Wes Moore

name: Paige for Congress
subject: ICE can't be reformed. It must be abolished!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Paige Beauchemin for Congress
body:
| |
---
Power, Prosperity, Peace
| Dear Friend, Our hearts are heavy over the news of three ICE-related deaths in less than a week. We stand with the immigrant community. We with the people of Texas, Maine and now Florida. This loss of life is senseless. **All three of these men should still be here**.
* * *
**ENOUGH IS ENOUGH**
* * *
In fact, these men could still be here, had many members of Congress**not voted for the Laken Riley Act which broadened mandated detention of immigrants**. This act is a contributing factor to ICE's increased aggression and rampant, untrained presence in our communities. We need leaders who will do what is right and stand up for **all people**. What happened to Laken Riley is horrible but to truly stand against violence, we need programs that address its root causes and aim to prevent it. None of this is accomplished by the Laken Riley Act. Instead, we scapegoat entire populations and create more violence, brutality and hate.
* * *
**PAIGE'S PLEDGE**
* * *
While our opponent signs the Promise to America pledge and remains silent on her vote **_for_** the Laken Riley Act, Paige is [pledging to abolish ICE](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/jfhlVOjhQy7FFJfzbN1y4Or4MgYBQfAX/click?signature=aa103ee3765160bce70ef214f4d4c75a0950534f&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DQV5-jLTboVQ). We need more leaders who will take this pledge. We need leaders who don't cave to racist narratives. We need leaders who won't vote for acts like the Laken Riley Act. We need leaders who are willing to invest in community resources and not use white-supremacist-coded language, like the Promise to America’s calls for “safety, not lawlessness.”.
* * *
**THE NEED TO ABOLISH ICE**
* * *
ICE was created less than 25 years ago in the aftermath of 9/11. It has always been used as a tool to uphold white supremacy. **A racist, violent system cannot be reformed. It can only be abolished.** We must end this blatant xenophobia. It needs to be replaced with thoughtful immigration policy. This is the mission and these are the values Paige will bring to DC. She will demand accountability, demand the abolition of ICE, and demand humane treatment of immigrants. If this is the type of leadership you want to see in DC next year, consider getting involved in this movement. [Volunteer](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/jfhlVOjhQy7FFJfzbN1y4Or4MgYBQfAX/click?signature=de8a914741d68ca50d8be2890b8199c3f7ebd052&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F22SxP9UZzC) [Join the Discord Community](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/jfhlVOjhQy7FFJfzbN1y4Or4MgYBQfAX/click?signature=de8a914741d68ca50d8be2890b8199c3f7ebd052&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F22SxP9UZzC) [Try Relational Organizing](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/jfhlVOjhQy7FFJfzbN1y4Or4MgYBQfAX/click?signature=5abdbaf827e1749c61fd652e3a9e1d40aa512194&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.paigefornh.com%2Fget-organized) We won't sit by as our neighbors and communities are terrorized. **We will demand change. We will elect new leaders.** In Solidarity, Team Paige

subject: The earthquake is over. The hunt for children has begun.
body:
Peter, the disaster made headlines. This part didn't.
After the earthquakes in Venezuela, traffickers are already moving. Here's how we're responding.

| | | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=861f59f57f784d10a680e6d126eba281&_e=pJU4YLNsZfDK2RfLwwgmIhaFEoG9p_u8L_Euh7CT_8Zto2OST3eu77kG2gC9UGDqo-lRCnoAXaWUEwkzmfWRFvuFuOx_-A5PiywnpzOYOS5uqWGuWxf3vvViA_ilpLhbrw87TZitotOlcZKuKw_i0cLiL6CT2oJCWU38CyIqTtN5MvKUIT0W9r2Hkgn737Tji7TNbrf4kFJDhhSBkOsvRJlQsjVojxn7HDLsmUxaBMFee12bUnC_pPSn0TMF_Jgk8dZHBqlgBRYM30Lw8DzhmtIdACjsOkX2_2ZScH8CMilB9S2Sl8Fi7dWWzFDh_t7aYajl5QEUJ7ChsWbYhdp_B1DfWkXsIkXqnhOqLueQtqm0901SS6Q6DqDnOmOSWQOqPDrqg2EnZLMvStiQ3EpDc-11HrqaQZ410mAGjz1JkAVKspXh0WAJcvJfgNBYlfbRiFvsa292WY_ks_xv0mt3Cc3hbPbrTaEHNesD0oXZ7X3fOaFGLt08-E1vSXK2dckgNno1b_jG33h9qoGKSSJGwbt1262Rmf947zlgfI5a8CTeVWcerHgb_Na8hR2i97YowjVLwtfCp23drbvhMlApKiGKenUb33dGW8xcBz0z-lfRY5r0cj-PswfxTC2OeVTByaHC4STr7W5SP1Po34Y6zuyI1yCCamex6jiqB1twC0o0vuNizH9VMHvg8PEYC8HV)
---
| |
---
| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Peter,
---
The earthquakes in Venezuela dominated the news for a matter of days. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, **the world watched, then largely moved on.** But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. **In some ways, it was only the beginning.** Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear.
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=861f59f57f784d10a680e6d126eba281&_e=pJU4YLNsZfDK2RfLwwgmIhaFEoG9p_u8L_Euh7CT_8Zto2OST3eu77kG2gC9UGDqo-lRCnoAXaWUEwkzmfWRFvuFuOx_-A5PiywnpzOYOS5uqWGuWxf3vvViA_ilpLhbrw87TZitotOlcZKuKw_i0cLiL6CT2oJCWU38CyIqTtN5MvKUIT0W9r2Hkgn737Tji7TNbrf4kFJDhhSBkOsvRJlQsjVojxn7HDLsmUxaBMED9XntTRiADQ7CNfMu26vGUH3ndhPnFd_KQyiMlof8mtp_L-DBJa7ZdpEOPs3AJ-fm-F2jQgSQNHZelRIP_INvpj50MDdkWDmm5wBV2Dnwq2sSASopoMB8lsm5QOkCHs9_rV5H_oGDnaiUNtP2jmU0eB0OSOPlkeSyWHZ26g67MBCsZCruqPwaoz35Uf3w2Ks-u5NV_FSgO_8F15rzm1gDY_kiMwz7eZ_ylg2wdpiCL54HenEchqpVBz81M9lFJ5TXJqNdl4RfqhasanQyEtMVXbNbFGONhazckkLnMydLBMwzo5D9K2J6KeegcRBc9i6R0-vNEwvcbExdizA3mdnFx_WcxMddpVTzOrAL14X3aabnAv8IJM1VVRa17CVVBwYPfCGac-nU5PjwQiuvAPUW1NRUfGw9ShfF6Knwb7U4tH9uGPEkRjRPG5YkL8MTm5uH7VBsIuHEGmi_6_rBG7uQ)

subject: Oregon’s elections are safe and secure — no matter what Donald Trump says
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
This week, the Trump Justice Department sent my office another threatening letter.
Their message was clear: Stop protecting the privacy of Oregon voters and hand over sensitive voter information— or face the consequences including my potential imprisonment
My answer was just as clear: No.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
Oregon's elections are secure, accurate, and fair. That's not my opinion — it's the result of decades of hard work by local election officials who follow the law, protect voters' privacy, and administer our elections with integrity.
Instead of providing evidence of widespread voter fraud, the Justice Department is once again resorting to threats and manufactured controversy.
I'm not intimidated. And I'm not going to let politicians in Washington interfere with Oregon's elections.
That's why we've challenged illegal attempts to interfere with our elections and defended Oregon's vote-by-mail system — and that's why we'll keep fighting, as many times as it takes.
But we can’t do this work alone. So if you believe Oregon's elections should be run by Oregonians — not politicians in Washington — will you support my campaign and make a contribution today? Thank you for standing with me. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]

My campaign is behind on our mid-month goal — and Election Day is closer than it feels. Here's why that matters for the whole country. |

Fellow Conservative,

I want to lay out exactly where things stand, because I think you'd want to know.

My name is Mike Carey, and I represent Ohio's 15th Congressional District — _one of the most targeted Republican seats in the country._ Right now, we are behind on our mid-month fundraising goal. Not by a little. By enough that it concerns me.

In my first race for Congress, just two votes per precinct made the difference and helped carry me over the finish line.
That's it: Two conversations, two neighbors showing up, two people deciding their voice mattered.
In 2024, we won again — but only by a little more than three percent.
Now, as we gear up for another election, the lesson hasn't changed.
A new poll released yesterday showed my opponent and me statistically tied.
This district is competitive because the people who live here think for themselves. They don't hand out votes based on party labels, and they expect their representative to earn their trust.
I've always respected that. That’s why I don't take corporate PAC money or vote the party line just because someone tells me to. And that's also why every contribution to this campaign matters.
In a district this close, there is no such thing as a donation that doesn't make a difference. A contribution today might help us knock on one more door, run one more digital ad, and reach one more independent voter who hasn't made up their mind.
When elections are decided by just a handful of votes in every community, those things matter. Friend --
Today I am endorsing Matt Maasdam to be the next Congressman from mid-Michigan and represent Michigan's seventh congressional district. Mid-Michigan is where it all began for me, representing this district – from Charlotte, to Lansing, to Owosso, to Brighton, to South Lyon – in the U.S. House for six years.
[**Join me in supporting Matt Maasdam’s campaign for Michigan’s 7th district today.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-maasdam.FaIw1O&refcode=em260629&t=3&akid=2483%2E135344%2EC8yaz1)**
Matt has spent his life serving our country as a Navy SEAL and in the White House for President Obama. When he retired from the military, he chose to move back to Michigan to raise his family. Matt could have chosen lots of other paths, but he believes that service to the people of Michigan is the most important path he can take.
We need fighters, and whether it is standing up to President Trump's attacks on our democracy, taking on the corruption and special interests, or standing up for working people -- he knows what it means to fight. I look forward to working alongside Matt to win the primary election in August, and then flip this seat in November to re-take the House majority.
[**Please join me in supporting Matt’s campaign today.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-maasdam.FaIw1O&refcode=em260629&t=4&akid=2483%2E135344%2EC8yaz1)**

HUGE NEWS: The race for Alaska’s U.S. Senate seat is officially a toss-up.
🔥

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260715-1-split.Krs3cB&refcode=em20260715-61633&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=61633%2E1407376%2EEE05ph ]Tweet from @PollTracker2024: Cook Political Report ratings change. US
Senate Alaska: Lean Republican → Toss-up

First it was VoteHub. Then Sabato’s Crystal Ball. Then Split Ticket. And
now, Cook Political Report – some of America’s most renowned elections
experts. All acknowledging what we’ve known since we launched this
campaign in January: This race is a toss-up, and we can win it in
November.

We have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to flip this seat and take back
Alaska. And I know we can do it because I’ve won statewide in Alaska –
twice! – against our former governor Sarah Palin.

We can’t afford to miss this opportunity. That’s why we’re outworking our
opponent – traveling by plane, boat, caravan, and more to reach rural
communities all across our state and have as many conversations with
voters as possible.

And everywhere I go, I hear the same thing: Alaskans are ready for a
change.

We’re ready to take on the rigged system in DC that lets politicians line
their own pockets and pad their stock portfolios while working Alaskans
get crushed. We’re tired of watching our senator triple his personal
wealth in office while we can barely afford to get by. And we’re ready to
do something about it.

That’s why this race is a toss-up. Because no amount of dark money
spending from DC groups or billionaire-backed super PACs can beat the
power of Alaskans coming together to demand a government that works for
us.

The entire political establishment in DC is mobilizing against us – but
because of you, they’re failing. Despite dedicating $20 million (and
counting) against me with attack ads, we’re continuing to gain momentum.

That’s because of you and the support you’ve given me over the past six
months. I’m beyond grateful. But with just over 100 days to go until
Election Day, a lot could still change.

If we’re going to compete with the onslaught of attack ads and win the
most competitive and expensive Senate race in the country, we’re going to
need a lot of resources. That’s the only way we’ll keep up the momentum
and win this toss-up race – [ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260715-1-split.Krs3cB&refcode=em20260715-61633&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=61633%2E1407376%2EEE05ph ]which is why today, I’m asking you to split
a donation between Demand Justice PAC and my campaign.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260715-1-split.Krs3cB&amount=5&refcode=em20260715-61633&t=1021&akid=61633%2E1407376%2EEE05ph ]Donate $5 ››

I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: We are going to win this race.
And we’re going to win it together.

Thanks for being with me.

- Mary

I’m beyond grateful. But with just over 100 days to go until Election Day, a lot could still change. If we’re going to compete with the onslaught of attack ads and win the most competitive and expensive Senate race in the country, we’re going to need a lot of resources. That’s the only way we’ll keep up the momentum and win this toss-up race – [ ]which is why today, I’m asking you to split a donation between Demand Justice PAC and my campaign. [ ]Donate $5 ›› I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: We are going to win this race. And we’re going to win it together. Thanks for being with me. - Mary

body:
Polis’s auto insurance roadmap is working. It’s also avoiding the hard part.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends,
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Colorado stays[ 5th priciest for auto insurance ($3,222/yr) despite Polis's roadmap](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and a 34% theft drop. [Primary ballot audits are underway](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.); Mesa County found zero discrepancies. New gun licensing rules (SB25-003) [start August 1](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Pilot Nicholas Dale, 56, [died fighting the Gold Mountain Fire](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) when his helicopter crashed. Feds signed $528.6M deal with GEO Group to nearly [double Colorado's ICE detention capacity](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** Ex-HHS official John Fabbricatore says 291,000 of ~540,000 unaccompanied migrant children under Biden went unaccounted for; a [Trump-era taskforce has found 140,000](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Helen Comperatore, widow of Corey Comperatore — killed shielding his family in the 2024 Trump assassination attempt — spoke publicly for the first time, [joining calls for more records' release.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Joe Oltmann [casts the Tina Peters case as whistleblower persecution](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), not election denial, saying she preserved rather than tampered with Mesa County data and that Trump's pardon reflects that. He pushes reforms like photo ID and ending mass mail voting.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, July 15, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Polis’s auto insurance roadmap is working. It’s also avoiding the hard part.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Last November, Governor Jared Polis stood before cameras and announced a Roadmap to Reduce Auto Insurance Premiums. Colorado had the fifth-highest auto insurance rates in the nation. His administration had a plan. Eight months later, the state has hit most of its targets — and Colorado is still fifth.
Polis built the roadmap around enforcement, education and infrastructure — plus legislation he had already signed. What it doesn’t do is ask the legislature for anything new. There would be a public dashboard so Coloradans could watch it happen. Most targets were met. The ranking hasn’t moved.
What the roadmap doesn’t address is a separate question, one that insurance industry analysts say explains why Colorado pays more than its neighbors.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s primary audit is underway. Here’s what it checks—and what it doesn’t](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Mesa County completed its audit with zero discrepancies — but a clean result is a narrow finding about vote tabulation, not a comprehensive review of election integrity._
* Colorado's risk-limiting audit compares randomly selected paper ballots against how voting systems recorded them, using a publicly reproducible random seed generated by rolling 20 dice at a public meeting — Mesa County's bipartisan audit board pulled 115 ballots and found zero discrepancies.
* Sample sizes are driven by margin of victory, not a fixed percentage — a blowout race may require as few as 118 ballots while a close race like the Republican gubernatorial primary required an estimated 312, with additional rounds mandated if the state's 3 percent risk limit isn't met.
* The audit does not examine voter eligibility, registration integrity, signature verification, citizenship, or residency — meaning a clean result confirms only that tabulation equipment counted sampled ballots correctly, not that the broader election was conducted without error.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[The Tina Peters trial became a fight over whether the system could withstand public inspection.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JOE OLTMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Joe Oltmann argues that Trump's pardon of Peters was a moral judgment millions already agreed with: she was punished not for endangering democracy, but for embarrassing the people who claim to run it._
* Oltmann frames Peters as a whistleblower who preserved election system records during a "trusted build" — and argues the state's response of prosecution rather than transparent public reconciliation is itself the tell that something worth examining was being protected.
* Drawing on Maricopa County, Georgia, and Tarrant County, Oltmann argues that what passes for election auditing is public-relations theater — that mass mail voting, bloated voter rolls, and proprietary black-box software each independently undermine the standard a true audit requires.
* Oltmann calls for photo ID for all voting methods, proof of citizenship at registration, an end to machine voting and mass mail ballots, precinct-level hand counting with publicly posted totals before transmission, and legal protection for election whistleblowers — arguing a republic should run on proof, not layered institutional trust.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY MIKE O'DONNELL | COMMENTARY | JULY 13**
_Questions about who belongs on Colorado's voter rolls extend beyond duplicate registrations. In Part 6, Mike O'Donnell examines how citizenship verification works, why he believes outside review is limited and how one Aurora apartment address became the most unusual pattern he encountered while reviewing Colorado's public voter roll._
__
**[America isn’t divided because we disagree](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY SEAN POND | COMMENTARY | JULY 13** _Every election, we’re told the same thing. If the left wins, America is finished. If the right wins, democracy is over. Both sides are convinced the next election will determine whether the country survives. The votes are counted, everyone catches their breath for a few weeks, and then the next campaign begins. The temperature goes right back up._ __
**[Lorena García’s nonprofit took $6.6 million in state money while its lobbyist backed bills she sponsored](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JULY 13** Before Lorena García was a Colorado state representative, the organization she runs had collected about $13,000 from the state of Colorado in the five years before she filled the vacancy, according to state payment records. That changed when she joined the legislature.

I've been on this earth long enough to recognize the red flags when I see them. For decades, people have told me the climate crisis is a problem for later. Deal with it in four years. Deal with it after the next election. Deal with it once the right leader comes along. I don't believe that, and the science doesn't either. That's why my team set a fundraising goal of $30,000 before Friday night. **The truth is, we are the first generation to truly feel the impacts of climate change, and the last that still has the power to stop it.**
It’s why my team and I have worked so hard to identify, endorse, and financially support hundreds of candidates since I founded the Jane Fonda Climate PAC in 2022. We’ve elected over 250 leaders together — from public service commissions all the way to Congress — with the backbone to stand up to corporate polluters and fight for people.
You’ve played a huge part in this work, and for that I am eternally grateful.
But with Big Oil billionaires and Donald Trump’s eyes set on the midterms, we have got to out-work, out-organize, and yes, even out-raise those who would rather poison our communities than see us thrive.
Some of the most consequential primaries of the year are still ahead of us in Michigan, Minnesota, and Arizona — races where we have the chance to elect extraordinary leaders who will take on corporate polluters, stand up to the unchecked expansion of power-hungry data centers, _and_ confront the cruelty of ICE.
**_The many can beat the money._**
**But it will take more than hope. It will take determination, and it will take people like you stepping up in the moments when we need you most.**

clean_body: Our planet doesn't have four more years. | I've been on this earth long enough to recognize the red flags when I see them. For decades, people have told me the climate crisis is a problem for later. Deal with it in four years. Deal with it after the next election. Deal with it once the right leader comes along. I don't believe that, and the science doesn't either. = = | = The truth is, we are the first generation to truly feel the impacts of climate change, and the last that still has the power to stop it. It’s why my team and I have worked so hard to identify, endorse, and financially support hundreds of candidates since I founded the Jane Fonda Climate PAC in 2022. We’ve elected over 250 leaders together — from public service commissions all the way to Congress — with the backbone to stand up to corporate polluters and fight for people. You’ve played a huge part in this work, and for that I am eternally grateful. But with Big Oil billionaires and Donald Trump’s eyes set on the midterms, we have got to out-work, out-organize, and yes, even out-raise those who would rather poison our communities than see us thrive. Some of the most consequential primaries of the year are still ahead of us in Michigan, Minnesota, and Arizona — races where we have the chance to elect extraordinary leaders who will take on corporate polluters, stand up to the unchecked expansion of power-hungry data centers, and confront the cruelty of ICE. The many can beat the money. But it will take more than hope. It will take determination, and it will take people like you stepping up in the moments when we need you most. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = In solidarity, – Jane = | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. body:
We’re doing this the Willie way.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter, I recently met with Willie Nelson, and I want to talk briefly about how he’s impacted me on the campaign trail.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260715_2_willie.r6_aa1&refcode=em20260715-1576&amount=5&t=1&akid=1576%2E299639%2EYXC9hL)
Willie Nelson is a legendary musician, but to us, he represents the true embodiment of what it means to be a Texan.
For decades, Republican leaders have constantly tried to paint our state as far-right and extreme.
But Willie embodies the absolute best of who we really are — **the idea that you can be a cowboy, a rancher, a weirdo, or whatever you want to be, as long as you are just a good human being.**
Throughout his life, Willie has never been afraid to use his voice for everyday people, and that’s the exact campaign I’m trying to build.

body:
Take Chairman Hudson's official patriotism survey.
| Dear Friend,
It's Chairman Hudson, and I need to tell you something concerning.
As America approaches its 250th year, a recent report found that patriotism isn't as strong as it should be. A recent survey found that only 30% of Americans think the United States is the greatest country in the world.
What a shame!
At a moment when we should be celebrating the greatest nation in history, too many Americans are losing pride in our country and the values that made it exceptional.
House Republicans are working every day to strengthen our economy, secure our borders, defend our freedoms, and preserve the American Dream for future generations.

This is the most exciting time for our work to reach, register and turn out new voters in Texas. I'd love your help to keep it going.
After a strong spring semester working with students on campuses across the state, we have sent our volunteers and organizers this summer to concerts (from Willie Nelson’s 4th of July Picnic to Sparta’s shows in San Antonio and Houston), festivals, clubs, community colleges and everywhere that Texas voters and future voters gather.

| | | | | | Peter, did you see this?
For years, Josh Shapiro has carefully cultivated an image as a strong, pragmatic leader.
But now, even the national media is acknowledging what Pennsylvanians have been seeing for themselves.
**Axios published a brutal analysis this week concluding that Josh Shapiro is unwilling to stand up to the radical wing of his own party.**
---
| [READ THE AXIOS STORY](https://us.list-manage.com/VctRS8l0yat?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| | | | | | This isn’t an isolated example.
Time and again, Josh Shapiro has shown that when the political pressure rises, he folds.
He once supported school choice, but when the teachers’ unions pushed back, he abandoned Pennsylvania families. Today, our Commonwealth ranks near the bottom nationally in education, and nearly 70% of Pennsylvania eighth graders cannot read at grade level. He has even refused to participate in the new federal education choice scholarship program that states across the political spectrum has embraced.
Whether it’s standing up to the far left, confronting special interests, or making difficult decisions, Josh Shapiro consistently puts political ambition ahead of leadership.
Pennsylvania deserves a governor with the courage to lead, not someone who changes positions whenever it’s politically convenient.
Take a few minutes to read the Axios analysis for yourself.

---
| |
Dear Friend,
Recent polling shows the Walker Hoffbeck campaign is competitive for one of the four spots that will advance from the August primary.
The polling also confirms that Alaskans want experienced leadership. They want a governor who can move the Alaska LNG project from promise to reality. Bill Walker is the only candidate with a proven record of bringing the market and all stakeholders to the table to advance the LNG project. Voters have confidence that Bill Walker and Randy Hoffbeck have the knowledge and relationships needed to help finally get the gasline built.
The polling also shows strong support for truly connecting an annual dividend to Alaska’s natural resource wealth. Alaskans want a dividend that is stable, dependable, and has the potential to grow as our state prospers. We have proposed an Alaska Resource Dividend with a $1,000 annual guarantee with growth opportunity. An Alaska Resource Dividend would be determined mathematically and would not consume legislative debate every year. [That’s exactly what we’re working to deliver](https://us.list-manage.com/xcXwsS5sDLL?e=b6cf32d1c2&c2id=bccaf449ed2960725e09a7036fc7e612).
This campaign has never been about slogans or political labels. It’s about solving problems, balancing Alaska’s finances, developing our resources responsibly, and securing a stronger future for our families and yours.
Our first campaign finance report is due this Friday. If you’re able, we would be grateful for[ a contribution of any amount](https://us.list-manage.com/KF2WyRhVe3E?e=b6cf32d1c2&c2id=bccaf449ed2960725e09a7036fc7e612) to help us continue reaching voters across Alaska.
Together, we can move Alaska forward with integrity, experience, and solutions.
Thank you for your encouragement, your confidence, and your support
**Bill Walker** \- Candidate for Governor**Randy Hoffbeck** \- Candidate for Lieutenant Governor

P.S. Every contribution, [whether it’s $26, $50, $100, or any amount you choose](https://us.list-manage.com/vCAPmIVzqkD?e=b6cf32d1c2&c2id=bccaf449ed2960725e09a7036fc7e612), helps us build the campaign Alaska deserves. Thank you for standing with us.

#
# **More Money for Pennsylvania Schools!**

****

Over the weekend, Senator Hughes came to Harrisburg to work with Governor Shapiro and House Democrats to pass a budget that delivers for the people of Pennsylvania.
Part of the budget funding included [$565M for adequacy and equity education funding](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17875). This adequacy investment is the **third round of education** funding lawmakers are providing to fix Pennsylvania's broken education funding system.

[](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17875)

**Why is Adequacy Funding Important?**
[](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17876)
After making adequacy and equity investments for the past 2 years, schools are already seeing positive momentum and improvements in classrooms. We must continue to fund our schools adequately and equitably so all Pennsylvania students can have equal access to a 21st century education.
By fully funding schools for the past two years, we've been able to:
* Increase learning opportunities and resources
* Provide better teacher/student ratios
* Provide more after school programs
* Open more opportunities for full-day Kindergarten (moving from half-day to full-day)
* Give teachers better training
* Provide more access to social workers, guidance counselors, and language learning support
* Provide more inclusive programming for students with disabilities

**The Fight Continues **
****
We must remember that **this money is not guaranteed every year**. For the past three years, Senator Hughes and state Democrats have had to fight for adequacy funding and make clear to Republicans that our schools are a top priority.
We are committed to continuing to fight for these important investments and the overall betterment of our schools. We will not walk away from this commitment to our students, teachers, and school administrators.

**Stay in Touch on Social Media**
If you haven't visited Senator Hughes' [**Facebook page**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17877), join the conversation by 'liking' the page and following our office on [**Instagram**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17878), [**TikTok**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17879), [**X**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17880), and [**Bluesky**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172075.172702.98&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17868),. We have lots of information available on these pages about community events and issues affecting our district.

Dear Friend,

Imagine growing up in a country where owning a Bible is illegal.

Where the name of Jesus is not spoken in public. Where choosing to follow Christ could cost you your family, your job, or your freedom. Where a missionary can’t get a visa.

For millions of people, this is not a hypothetical. It is everyday life.

This summer, many of them are coming to the World Cup.

They are coming to cheer for their national team and experience something larger than themselves. When they arrive in cities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, they will step into something they never experienced before — a place where someone can walk up to them, hand them a Gospel of John in their language, and tell them about Jesus without anyone stopping it.

_This moment is what we are preparing for._

IMB teams will be on the ground in Fan Zones and near stadiums throughout the tournament. Trained volunteers will be ready to have conversations, distribute resources, and connect fans with digital discipleship tools in their language that they can take home — back to countries where that kind of follow-up would otherwise be impossible.

For some of these fans, this will be the only time in their lives they are handed the gospel freely.

We cannot show up unprepared.

You can help us be ready by giving a gift today.

Here is what your gift does:

* $25 — 200 evangelism tracts placed directly into the hands of fans
* $50 — 25 soccer patches for sparking evangelistic conversations
* $100 — 100 Gospel of John booklets
* $250 — Rents an English Club outreach location where fans can hear the gospel in a welcoming space

At the Paris Olympics and the Winter Olympics, this approach worked. Thousands of spiritual conversations occurred. Tens of thousands of New Testaments were distributed. People made commitments to Christ during conversations with our teams. People interested in the gospel connected with discipleship tools that followed them home to their own countries.

The World Cup is far-reaching. The opportunity to connect with people who have never had access to hear the gospel is greater than anything we have seen at a single event.

But only if we are there, fully funded and fully prepared.

**Will you give today to ensure our teams are on the ground and ready for the World Cup?**

We are absolutely thrilled to be endorsed by Our Revolution in our campaign to make Public Power Work for the Public Good

| | | | | | Hi Peter,

Something that not enough folks talk about is how much Wisconsin has been a leader in our country. We were the first state to have unemployment insurance, we invested in our education system so our public schools were the best in the nation for decades, and [we created the modern income tax to take the burden off of property taxes](https://us.list-manage.com/govDlTlIchY?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09).
I’m proud to be part of that tradition, the Wisconsin Idea that puts our collective well-being first and calls on us to love our neighbors. I am absolutely thrilled to be endorsed by [Our Wisconsin Revolution](https://us.list-manage.com/10bK4aHvIii?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09) in our campaign to make Public Power Work for the Public Good.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/9WXJ62ZneGl?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |

Our Wisconsin Revolution formation was inspired by Bernie Sanders’ run for president in 2016 and his call for a political revolution, and is part of a national movement. Our Wisconsin Revolution is part of the national movement of people all over the country supporting a new generation of progressive leaders and empowering millions to fight for progressive change and transforming our political and economic systems to once again be responsive to the needs of working families.

I am so excited to be their chosen representative for State Treasurer at a time when we need to fight the concentration of power in the hands of a few.
Our campaign has less than four weeks left until election day. Early voting in person begins on July 28th, and we need your help getting out the word.****[**If you’re able, please consider giving a donation to power our people-first campaign. Giving any amount $10, $25, $50 or more, goes a long way in this final stretch.**](https://us.list-manage.com/AxSCNwyfExK?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
Please share our campaign with your friends! Please let them know how important this moment is to help us get Wisconsin back to where it was as the progressive heart of the nation. There are candidates out there fighting for all of us, and I am so proud to have Our Wisconsin Revolutions' stamp of approval as one of those folks.
Thank you for believing in this campaign and helping us put power back in working people’s hands.
Sincerely,Dylan

name: KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION
subject: Spending is out of control.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
With rising prices, higher property taxes, and increased costs for just about everything, families have learned to do more with less. Not Mike Kelly.

| | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends,Johnson County families have had to make tough financial decisions over the last several years. With rising prices, higher property taxes, and increased costs for just about everything, families have learned to do more with less.Unfortunately, the Johnson County government has done the opposite.Over the past five years, the county budget has grown from approximately **$1.26 billion to $1.83 billion**. That's a 45% increase, and taxpayers are the ones footing the bill. Yet homeowners continue to ask a simple question: where are the results?My opponent, Mike Kelly, has been part of the leadership that has allowed this explosive growth in spending. Instead of demanding accountability and putting taxpayers first, the budget has continued to grow while property tax bills have climbed higher and higher.I believe the county government should live within its means, just like every family and every small business in Johnson County.As your County Commission Chair, I will fight to:
* Cut unnecessary spending and eliminate waste.
* Conduct a top-to-bottom review of county departments and programs.
* Restore transparency to the budgeting process.
* Prioritize essential services instead of expanding bureaucracy.
* Fight for meaningful property tax relief for homeowners and seniors.

Our government doesn't have a revenue problem. It has a spending problem.Johnson County deserves leadership that understands every dollar the government spends comes from the hardworking people who earned it. I'll ask the tough questions, challenge unnecessary spending, and always put taxpayers first.If you're ready for a County Commission that lives within its means and fights for your family instead of a bigger government, early voting starts this Saturday. If you want to vote early here is the list of polling locations and times [click here](https://us.list-manage.com/ocCRLl9Ugkb?e=7320325a61&c2id=7adf4106091b2bdf32986c5b36d3a494)! I’d be honored to have your support.Together, we can restore fiscal responsibility to Johnson County.Sincerely,Karen Crnkovich
Candidate for Johnson County Commission

# 20 Days Left.
---
| |
### _And not a mile is wasted..._
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Virginia’s First District spans 480 miles. Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs is the candidate showing up for you. **To prove it** , she’s been running the entirety of it. Every mile she runs across VA-01 is another opportunity to hear directly from the people she hopes to represent.
On the road, Elizabeth truly gets to know her constituents. What she is hearing isn't complicated. Families want someone who will make life more affordable, protect Social Security, root out corruption in Washington, and stand up for communities facing unchecked data center development. They aren't asking for more political drama; they want results.
With just 20 days until Election Day, there isn't time to waste. Every remaining mile is another chance to meet voters before they cast their ballots. Every conversation is another opportunity to earn a vote. But reaching every community takes resources, and this campaign is powered by people like you, not corporate PACs or special interests.
Elizabeth is doing the hard part. She's putting in the miles, showing up in communities that many politicians overlook, and earning trust one conversation at a time.
Now we're asking you to help carry this campaign through the rest of primary season.
Will you sponsor the next mile with a contribution of $20 today? Your donation will help us keep Elizabeth on the road, reach more voters, and finish this race as strongly as we've run it from the very beginning.
Thank you for believing that the best campaigns are built by showing up, listening first, and earning every vote.
