Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. Friend, We lost two fathers this week: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo and Johan Sebastián Durán**** Guerrero. While aggressively driving unmarked vehicles, ICE agents racially profiled, shot, and murdered Lorenzo and Johan as they drove to work in Texas and Maine. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amCFRW0xmmmK_f0uSKvVa66J2rrhiQ7UunrXLu3Q2Qp11FIp5Ub2uWGs5e5WLTRehHJF_lf0jyni2xkMg-rG73s-JFcwx-cJ-8qmuktg0PHliS3DyZVcbTUdS_j9xjYS31wKNzsNbH7MLSkB2Q-o7G9pWgjjNzFhNM2vQreVuCB1tE8-ioz5KYg0LU0oQth3L0EuLOCWABE2FElBBt3WZajn_z559DYpxYcd5LhWNXHYbCFNiDLi0uCKQixAtXMzYhRKjpd_GmySbXJbwtIpEfXnXSCShll4UYeSd_skp9Wz_RK1wqAO-kmjEwNqshRzQC-0pHex1znwCpaMxoPozPFAL3Lnk0yoxrtLr51fmUDiENcRcFLwDAE1FgH9L0_wiUyJNuq-zX1JRcRnJwq9dBqQHq-rjQeroVfRfLhlNH4aCbcBnInCQKgxxxfOTYAstqIvZQdpZmlYRvF4V6fnUj6g/4sc/URIxC3TcSTS4aWpcBgft9A/h1/h001.T4NxrVyoAl2koJVeWlP4Yx-rqcJksGSZMbHN0X9yv4c) Johan was only 26 years old. A few days ago he posted a photo of his 3-year-old daughter, writing in Spanish: “I love you my beautiful princess.” Lorenzo’s children describe him as a family man who liked to listen to music on his porch with his dog. **They are human beings, they are not disposable, and they should still be alive today. Their families deserve accountability.** But currently, government employees such as federal immigration agents are protected by “qualified immunity,” which shields them from the legal consequences of their actions. They must be held responsible for hurting our communities and violating our rights, so**I’ve introduced policies to end qualified immunity**. In another recent attack on our immigrant neighbors, **the corrupt Supreme Court greenlit Trump’s effort to strip crucial protections from Haitian and Syrian immigrants who have Temporary Protected Status (TPS)**. The Center for Constitutional Rights wrote:_“This ruling will kill people.”_ Temporary Protected Status is a life-saving program that protects U.S. residents from 17 designated countries that are too dangerous to return to. Over 336,000 Syrian and Haitian people could lose their TPS and face deportation this month. [**Please sign on to demand Congress save lives by extending protections for Haitian and Syrian immigrants who’ve built their lives here, and by ending qualified immunity for ICE agents so they can be prosecuted for their crimes.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amCFRW0xmmmK_f0uSKvVa66J2rrhiQ7UunrXLu3Q2Qp11FIp5Ub2uWGs5e5WLTRehHJF_lf0jyni2xkMg-rG73s-JFcwx-cJ-8qmuktg0PHliS3DyZVcbTUdS_j9xjYS31wKNzsNbH7MLSkB2Q-o7G9pWgjjNzFhNM2vQreVuCB1tE8-ioz5KYg0LU0oQth3L0jDgl5orNnggahKr2eqzzaaH9Vb_-qtMJNnMd3L6RLbVGLhLP5HIktkNzRnj6InH1QK1NxRMGfIRIghZVoh0ksAbNqAb_ZupvjVjolCJaXQp5XpEnhUnh-OI34wE99kvgwNnhRrEj7bfIvLZyeRHz9IIVTSDmlCjeRJ7TGgMRwsHb0IhFPCRm9jKD0kBx4-4tFgMAIIAMQBKWDctz6NDtAk-6eWqfnbOTXYNFLKqhrRko35XqbOm9Y8gozX8bQNvYM2nqLavyLKwHUfh0jZ0Wsg/4sc/URIxC3TcSTS4aWpcBgft9A/h2/h001.GBLaYHHu5FMf_TJ2JyG9592-SPbXVAkVSiL4zHDUu8s) | [SIGN ON TO SAVE LIVES](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amCFRW0xmmmK_f0uSKvVa66J2rrhiQ7UunrXLu3Q2Qp11FIp5Ub2uWGs5e5WLTRehHJF_lf0jyni2xkMg-rG73s-JFcwx-cJ-8qmuktg0PHliS3DyZVcbTUdS_j9xjYS31wKNzsNbH7MLSkB2Q-o7G9pWgjjNzFhNM2vQreVuCB1tE8-ioz5KYg0LU0oQth3L0hAjffwu0rVlbUYkcFaQM757GXj96k3hi4V06g1wX1CTitPMddsesVKFrP3Y62tOSXEd1yVlVnMYF_pxG2EtiPLZyarYBCA_fOezVItRVAC4S6MBkyAPbgpH52yoVFvfi1ToBYe7lyNA7dbd3fIfFweZMlKioagxFkWT_fgPqXc7JxbOy1ynR9YUG2IQrcXmL0CH6FAvhWMi4TA_QxOQwIQkga1WSxgxG8fyHcXOt5OgzzlVepLbT-wAX3zXYKidwVRmYUwsMRKV8E_LLAvRojQ/4sc/URIxC3TcSTS4aWpcBgft9A/h3/h001.HNfBYzVQtQuPt4HewVe-7L6iCkQYls3jXSBKatwphD0)

**In Congress I’ve introduced and supported policies to redesignate and extend Temporary Protected Status** for immigrants from Syria, Haiti, Lebanon, Yemen, and more.
Temporary Protected Status holders already live and work in our communities. The program grants them work permits and protections from deportation and detention. It enables their safety while they apply for asylum, a green card, or citizenship.
In a bipartisan vote, the U.S. House of Representatives passed **legislation to extend Temporary Protected Status** for more than 300,000 Haitian nationals living in the United States, which my sister-in-service **Ayanna Pressley** led.
**The Senate must immediately pass this bill** , and both bodies of Congress must pass legislation to extend TPS for Syrians who face imminent deportation and heightened ICE violence without it.
One of the reasons ICE agents are so emboldened to terrorize our communities is because they know they can’t be prosecuted for their crimes. That’s why I’ve introduced the** _Justice for All Act_****** and co-sponsored Congresswoman Pressley’s******_Qualified Immunity Abolition Act_** , both of which would end qualified immunity — allowing ICE agents and other government employees to be held accountable for their actions.
**Our communities urgently need these policies.**
Since Trump’s second term began last January, federal immigration agents have killed at least 11 people in the streets. And at least 52 people have died inside ICE detention centers, some of whom were clearly murdered by guards.
And now, Trump’s Republican administration is doubling down on this terror. They’ve set a goal for ICE agents to arrest 2,000 people each day — massively expanding deadly ICE violence and detentions.
[**Fight back against Trump’s mass deportations and murders by demanding Congress act now to extend Temporary Protected Status for Haitian and Syrian residents and hold ICE agents accountable for their crimes against U.S. residents.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amCFRW0xmmmK_f0uSKvVa66J2rrhiQ7UunrXLu3Q2Qp11FIp5Ub2uWGs5e5WLTRehHJF_lf0jyni2xkMg-rG73s-JFcwx-cJ-8qmuktg0PHliS3DyZVcbTUdS_j9xjYS31wKNzsNbH7MLSkB2Q-o7G9pWgjjNzFhNM2vQreVuCB1tE8-ioz5KYg0LU0oQth3L04LYPjy9Vr4BW4z4tpIRCh9I-rW6oFLvotOSMmzocrikW0YYdyv8srPecsjF8iBT6wTVgI5kr21ihImeqDG3mgO7QthlpWFe6EDC-StAfSTrIZ2Q3_vt12CL5G_dhYFYAM8Z_AK4lYiBzdAmCOPtJ9OVX8WfnxuwTSqLlrmODy6vVJcob_qyeJqbkvWtpLw0ywNBEXxWOm1gcqGObQIa_9tPo6dV6B08khYg3KbCbrDVhAouTxXDZs5KYCCpfVei1ds0x6WYnbzfxJ9FxF-uRdA/4sc/URIxC3TcSTS4aWpcBgft9A/h4/h001.qj_INXzQjXA5mUWHliTWAFvdw9_05PPD6o0GuKHhAbM)

Thank you for taking action! When we build power and push back together, we can win.
For example, in Trump’s first term, we blocked his attempts to collect DNA from imprisoned immigrants, and defunded his programs that sent federal agents into U.S. cities.
And in his second term, our movement successfully pressured the Trump administration to back away from its plan to turn warehouses across our country into inhumane detention centers.
I will never stop working toward a just and humane immigration system. **I’m a daughter of immigrants and a former immigration lawyer and I will continue to use every tool I can to abolish ICE, fight back against Trump, and protect our communities.**
That includes:
* Introducing the _Ban Warehouse Detention Act_ — which successfully helped pressure the administration to let go of its plan to turn warehouses into detention centers
* Recently introducing the _Find Our Families Act_ to stop the Department of Homeland Security from disappearing people in detention centers
* Working with grassroots immigrant justice groups to train people on their rights
* Connecting immigrant families with free legal assistance
* Directly supporting hundreds of people on their path to obtaining citizenship

With you in the fight for justice and safety for all,

clean_body: Protect our immigrant loved ones and neighbors by urging Congress to hold ICE murderers accountable and extend protections for TPS holders. | | | Friend, We lost two fathers this week: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo and Johan Sebastián Durán** Guerrero. While aggressively driving unmarked vehicles, ICE agents racially profiled, shot, and murdered Lorenzo and Johan as they drove to work in Texas and Maine. Johan was only 26 years old. A few days ago he posted a photo of his 3-year-old daughter, writing in Spanish: “I love you my beautiful princess.” Lorenzo’s children describe him as a family man who liked to listen to music on his porch with his dog. They are human beings, they are not disposable, and they should still be alive today. Their families deserve accountability. But currently, government employees such as federal immigration agents are protected by “qualified immunity,” which shields them from the legal consequences of their actions. They must be held responsible for hurting our communities and violating our rights, soI’ve introduced policies to end qualified immunity. In another recent attack on our immigrant neighbors, the corrupt Supreme Court greenlit Trump’s effort to strip crucial protections from Haitian and Syrian immigrants who have Temporary Protected Status (TPS). The Center for Constitutional Rights wrote:“This ruling will kill people.” Temporary Protected Status is a life-saving program that protects U.S. residents from 17 designated countries that are too dangerous to return to. Over 336,000 Syrian and Haitian people could lose their TPS and face deportation this month. | In Congress I’ve introduced and supported policies to redesignate and extend Temporary Protected Status for immigrants from Syria, Haiti, Lebanon, Yemen, and more. Temporary Protected Status holders already live and work in our communities. The program grants them work permits and protections from deportation and detention. It enables their safety while they apply for asylum, a green card, or citizenship. In a bipartisan vote, the U.S. House of Representatives passed legislation to extend Temporary Protected Status for more than 300,000 Haitian nationals living in the United States, which my sister-in-service Ayanna Pressley led. The Senate must immediately pass this bill , and both bodies of Congress must pass legislation to extend TPS for Syrians who face imminent deportation and heightened ICE violence without it. One of the reasons ICE agents are so emboldened to terrorize our communities is because they know they can’t be prosecuted for their crimes. That’s why I’ve introduced the Justice for All Act**** and co-sponsored Congresswoman Pressley’s**Qualified Immunity Abolition Act , both of which would end qualified immunity — allowing ICE agents and other government employees to be held accountable for their actions. Our communities urgently need these policies. Since Trump’s second term began last January, federal immigration agents have killed at least 11 people in the streets. And at least 52 people have died inside ICE detention centers, some of whom were clearly murdered by guards. And now, Trump’s Republican administration is doubling down on this terror. They’ve set a goal for ICE agents to arrest 2,000 people each day — massively expanding deadly ICE violence and detentions. Thank you for taking action! When we build power and push back together, we can win. For example, in Trump’s first term, we blocked his attempts to collect DNA from imprisoned immigrants, and defunded his programs that sent federal agents into U.S. cities. And in his second term, our movement successfully pressured the Trump administration to back away from its plan to turn warehouses across our country into inhumane detention centers. I will never stop working toward a just and humane immigration system. I’m a daughter of immigrants and a former immigration lawyer and I will continue to use every tool I can to abolish ICE, fight back against Trump, and protect our communities. That includes: Introducing the Ban Warehouse Detention Act — which successfully helped pressure the administration to let go of its plan to turn warehouses into detention centers Recently introducing the Find Our Families Act to stop the Department of Homeland Security from disappearing people in detention centers Working with grassroots immigrant justice groups to train people on their rights Connecting immigrant families with free legal assistance Directly supporting hundreds of people on their path to obtaining citizenship With you in the fight for justice and safety for all, Rashida * Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . **Peter, Donald Trump can’t get over the fact that we have currently stopped the SAVE Act, one of the most dangerous legislative threats to our democracy.** If this extreme MAGA policy passes, it would make voting more difficult for millions of Americans:
* Registering to vote would require proving your citizenship via a U.S. Passport or your original birth certificate.
* Tens of millions of women who have changed their last names would have to track down the requisite paperwork.
* Even typical forms of ID– military ID, tribal ID, or even REAL ID– won’t be accepted to prove citizenship under these SAVE Acts.
* In addition to simply acquiring the proper documentation, voters in rural communities and those living with disabilities would embark on long and arduous journeys to their election offices.

All of these challenges, coupled with an effective ban on online or mail-in voter registration, would have a devastating impact on access to voting. **Our grassroots effort to stop the SAVE Act has been effective so far — but we’re not winning the broader war.** Since MAGA legislators can’t get the SAVE Act through Congress, they’re turning to the state level. Now, 14 states have passed their own versions of the SAVE Act, with far less public attention — and more states are trying to follow suit. clean_body: We need your help to stop every last attempt to weaken our democracy | Peter, Donald Trump can’t get over the fact that we have currently stopped the SAVE Act, one of the most dangerous legislative threats to our democracy. If this extreme MAGA policy passes, it would make voting more difficult for millions of Americans: Registering to vote would require proving your citizenship via a U.S. Passport or your original birth certificate. Tens of millions of women who have changed their last names would have to track down the requisite paperwork. Even typical forms of ID– military ID, tribal ID, or even REAL ID– won’t be accepted to prove citizenship under these SAVE Acts. In addition to simply acquiring the proper documentation, voters in rural communities and those living with disabilities would embark on long and arduous journeys to their election offices. All of these challenges, coupled with an effective ban on online or mail-in voter registration, would have a devastating impact on access to voting. Our grassroots effort to stop the SAVE Act has been effective so far — but we’re not winning the broader war. Since MAGA legislators can’t get the SAVE Act through Congress, they’re turning to the state level. Now, 14 states have passed their own versions of the SAVE Act, with far less public attention — and more states are trying to follow suit. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = While most eyes have been on the congressional battle over the SAVE Act, Republican state lawmakers have enacted similar legislation requiring documentary proof of citizenship from all those registering to vote. In at least six states, this legislation will have an immediate effect on this year’s midterm elections. It’s clear: Trump and MAGA are willing to take every route possible to block Americans from making their voices heard. subject: The numbers don’t lie
body:
CNBC’s latest rankings reflect what Texans are experiencing every day.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Texas just slipped in CNBC’s annual ranking of America’s Top States for Business.
Why?
**Because after years of Greg Abbott’s leadership, our state has earned an “F” for quality of life and a “C” grade for education and cost of living.**
Texans don't need a report to tell them what they already know.
They're paying more for everyday necessities. Public schools are struggling. Families are watching the cost of living climb while their paychecks don't go nearly as far.
It didn't have to be this way.
Instead of investing in working Texans, Greg Abbott has prioritized his billionaire donors and well-connected special interests — while the people who built this state are left footing the bill.
**Texas should be leading the nation — _not_ falling behind.**
I believe we can build a Texas where working families can get ahead, where every child has access to a great public school, and where our economy works for the people who power it every day.
_**That's the future I'm fighting for.**_
But Greg Abbott and his billionaire backers aren't going to give up power without a fight. They're counting on outspending us and drowning out our message.
I'm counting on this grassroots team instead.

| | Hi Friend,

Every week in Congress, Lateefah shows up and delivers results for the East Bay.

Her leadership is grounded in lived experience – as a single mom raising two daughters, a disabled commuter who relies on BART, and an organizer who has witnessed the transformative power of education.

This is what happens when you send an organizer to Congress: since taking office, Lateefah has delivered more than $520 million in federal funding for the East Bay – **including over a million dollars last week alone.**

**[That's what showing up for working families looks like. **_Alameda Post:_[Congresswoman Simon Secures $250K of Federal Funding for College of Alameda, Laney College FabLabs](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135343711/633928769/-1035951374?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTc2NDc2YjItYTY4MC1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kMVb2B3w5jn_IhNmtk5-8xnmZPSbIfoWH_XWX5V0ujc=&emci=0e6476b2-a680-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=176476b2-a680-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=22554739)**

On Friday, Congresswoman Simon announced $850,000 in funding for new lighting at nine East Bay BART stations. These new LED lights will be three times brighter than the fluorescents, saving energy and increasing rider safety. Anyone who's waited on a dim platform after a late shift knows why this matters – and thanks to Lateefah's leadership, riders across the East Bay will be able to navigate BART safely and accessibly.

And earlier this week, **_Politico_ [featured the _America 250 Reproductive Justice Resolution,_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135343714/633928799/-1696682822?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTc2NDc2YjItYTY4MC1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kMVb2B3w5jn_IhNmtk5-8xnmZPSbIfoWH_XWX5V0ujc=&emci=0e6476b2-a680-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=176476b2-a680-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=22554739)** which Lateefah introduced alongside Reps. Sydney Kamlager-Dove and Ayanna Pressley – laying down the next steps of the reproductive justice movement as America celebrated its 250th birthday.

In Lateefah's words: "While Republicans are spending the 250th anniversary attacking our fundamental freedom, we have to name what the future can and should look like for women and families. We will fight until every person has the dignity, resources, and access to care that they deserve."

Lateefah knows these fights because she's lived them. body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=2638%2E251025%2Ed63ee1 ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=2638%2E251025%2Ed63ee1 ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

In June, The Wall Street Journal reported that the establishment schemed
to narrow Michigan’s Democratic primary candidate field in hopes of
defeating our campaign, because in their eyes, I’m “dangerous.”

Just a few weeks later, the field really did narrow to us vs. their
preferred candidate, Haley Stevens.

Here’s what I think of being called “dangerous.”

If you're the establishment, I'm dangerous.
If you're AIPAC, I'm dangerous.
If you're a corporate PAC, I'm pretty damn dangerous.

But to the working people of Michigan? Hell no.

Peter, I've never
taken a dime from a corporate PAC, and I never will.

I wrote the book on Medicare for All because I believe healthcare is a
right, not a line item on a billionaire’s earnings call.

I've spent my career going after the people who profit off making life
harder for working people, and I'm not about to stop now that I'm this
close to the U.S. Senate.

That's exactly why the establishment, AIPAC, and corporate PACs are
spending so much to stop us.

They’re betting we run out of steam, but I’m betting on this grassroots
team — and I really like our odds.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260715-3-ak.06s9Kl&amount=10&refcode=em20260715-2626&t=1004&akid=2638%2E251025%2Ed63ee1 ]Can you chip in $10 or any amount today to help us prove
them wrong?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260715-3-ak.06s9Kl&amount=10&refcode=em20260715-2626&t=1023&akid=2638%2E251025%2Ed63ee1 ]Donate $10 ››

In solidarity,

Abdul
